visualCharacteristics.structure: background image + h1/h2 title + text + pill CTA, one slide per row
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-bleed scroll-snap slides (480px min mobile, 420px tablet, max(440px, 32vw) desktop); dark gradient (bottom-up on mobile, left-to-right from 768px); white text left-aligned in the container; inverted white pill CTA; pause/play toggle + one dot per slide centered at the bottom; autoplay 5s looping, paused on hover/focus, stopped by any interaction, off under prefers-reduced-motion
